Short biography

Nolan Kido works with AI to build useful tools and make complicated ideas clearer. His interests connect practical technology, thoughtful living, tournament poker, and creative work.

A little more context

Nolan Kido works with AI on useful tools, writing, and creative projects. He is interested in where technology genuinely helps, what still calls for human judgment, and how to leave room for life beyond the screen. His personal website brings together practical technology, Living Well, tournament poker, and creative work, with selected essays, clearly labelled worked examples, and resources to use or explore.
